recommendations.speaker: Anders Ström
recommendations.reasoning: Anders believes nuclear power will make a comeback, especially in countries like Germany that shut down reactors and now import nuclear electricity. His uranium portfolio started end of last year and has almost doubled, with expectation of another doubling. He sees it as a solution to climate change through new technology.
recommendations.quote: Jag ser en jättepotential i det, vi har gjort en portfölj med mina medarbetare på Veralda, så har vi både köpt bolag som sysslar med att ta fram uran och uran i ETF, så att de följer helt enkelt uranpriset. Det där börjar vi med i slutet på förra året, den har nästan dubblats nu redan, och vi ser väl en dubbling till komma förhoppningsvis då.

recommendations.speaker: Anders Ström
recommendations.reasoning: As largest shareholder (17.5%), Anders is very bullish on Kambi's long-term prospects despite short-term volatility. The stock dropped due to concerns about Penn National Gaming developing inhouse, but Anders argues this is an equity story and that on the long run, companies will focus and outsource like BMW doesn't make its own tires. Kambi's Same Game Parley product and network effects give it competitive advantages.
recommendations.quote: Jag tror och är helt övertygad om att på lång sikt så kommer den här branschen att fungera som alla andra. För att det kommer att vara marginalpress, man behöver få ner kostnaderna och att alla bolag ska bygga sin egen sportbok med allt vad det innehåller. Det är inte bara oddsättning utan det är massor med olika funktioner. Det tror jag helt enkelt inte på.

recommendations.speaker: Anders Ström
recommendations.reasoning: Kindred is a major position in Veralda's portfolio. Anders discusses the temporary setback with Dutch regulation but believes it's a passing issue. He thinks Kindred's strong brand will allow them to recover quickly when they get their license. He's optimistic about management handling the situation.
recommendations.quote: Jag känner att det är en övergående grej ändå och jag hoppas att man förbereder sig så att när man väl öppnar upp igen så ska man snabbt kunna komma upp åtminstone i närheten av vad man var innan eftersom man ändå har ett så pass starkt varumärke som man har.

stock_segments.discussion_summary: Anders explains Kambi's business model as a sports betting provider spun out from Unibet. He addresses concerns about clients like Penn National Gaming potentially developing inhouse solutions, arguing this is driven by equity story needs rather than sound business logic. He emphasizes Kambi's competitive advantages including Same Game Parley product, network effects from operating multiple clients, and technical capabilities. Anders believes long-term, companies will specialize and outsource rather than build everything themselves.

summary: Anders Ström discusses his transition from chairman of Kindred to full-time investor with Veralda. He's bullish on Kambi's long-term prospects despite short-term volatility, sees the uranium sector as a major opportunity due to nuclear power comeback, and discusses challenges and opportunities in the gaming industry including regulatory issues and consolidation trends.
key_takeaways: Kambi has competitive advantages through network effects and Same Game Parley product
Uranium sector expected to double again as nuclear power makes comeback
Kindred facing temporary Dutch regulatory setback
Anders emphasizes 10-year planning horizons for business decisions
